description:
Analyzing and writing Oracle PL/SQL code (60%)  
 - Analyzing and upgrading Oracle Forms 11g (15%)  
 - Analyzing and upgrading Oracle Reports 11g (15%)  
 - Unit test, documentation, code review (10%)  

 

 Advanced knowledge of Oracle PL/SQL: Analyzing and writing PL/SQL. Ability to use advanced features such as ref cursors and built in packages  
 - Advanced knowledge of Oracle Forms/Reports: Advanced skill modifying and creating complex (non base table) forms and complex reports  
 - Beginner knowledge of Opencobol: ability to analyze and modify Opencobol modules  
 - Advanced knowledge of Oracle Database 10g/11g  
 - Advanced knowledge of Developer Unit test: Ability to perform comprehensive unit tests and provide adequate documentation of tasks  
 - Advanced knowledge of Developer code review: Ability to defend code and logic in a formal code review  
 - Intermediate knowledge of Korn Shell: Ability to analyze, modify and create Korn Shell scripts  
 - Intermediate knowledge of WebLogic Application Server: Experience developing Oracle Forms and Reports in a Weblogic environment.
